description: This file defines the CommentsController class, which manages HTTP requests related to comments in an ASP.NET Core application. It includes endpoints for creating, retrieving, and deleting comments associated with articles identified by a slug.

classes.name: CommentsController
classes.description: Controller handling comment-related HTTP requests, including creating, listing, and deleting comments, utilizing MediatR for command and query handling.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new comment on an article identified by slug, authenticated via JWT scheme.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve comments for an article identified by slug.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a comment identified by id from an article identified by slug, with authorization.
